name: term_water
query: LOOKUP ON passage WHERE ES_QUERY(nebula_index_ft_passage_1m, "water") YIELD id(vertex) AS vid, score() AS score, passage.text AS text | LIMIT 10;

name: phrase_new_york
query: LOOKUP ON passage WHERE ES_QUERY(nebula_index_ft_passage_1m, "\"New York\"") YIELD id(vertex) AS vid, score() AS score, passage.text AS text | LIMIT 10;

name: boolean_water_river
query: LOOKUP ON passage WHERE ES_QUERY(nebula_index_ft_passage_1m, "water AND river") YIELD id(vertex) AS vid, score() AS score, passage.text AS text | LIMIT 10;
